analyst_view.overall: Milan lost 2-0 at home to Ferencvaros in the Europa League on Thursday, and reports describe Ruben Amorim confronting the squad afterwards. Daniele De Rossi's Genoa have won three in a row. Milan are without Tomori, Gabbia, Saelemaekers, Loftus-Cheek and Chukwueze, and Pavlovic is a doubt after training on his own; Maignan, Modric and Pulisic are expected back in the starting XI.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. Genoa are in form after three straight wins, and Milan's defence is short of centre-backs, with Tomori and Gabbia out and Pavlovic uncertain. A Milan side that has to respond after the Ferencvaros defeat should also attack more, so we expect a bit more than the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Milan should have more of the ball and Genoa will attack in transition, which fits the model's even split. Nothing in the news moves this either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards, already a high figure that reflects Milan's card record and referee Davide Massa. A tense, under-pressure Milan could add to that, but the model already prices in a lively game.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.7 shots. With Pulisic, Modric and Ramos back in the side and Amorim demanding a reaction, Milan should shoot more than usual, and Genoa have been creating chances in their winning run.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target. A stronger Milan front line and an in-form Genoa attack facing a patched-up Milan back line both point to a few more efforts on target.
